entity.name: Engine_Consistent_Daily_Target
entity.description: Absorbed-iron target = UK RNI x the engine's fractional absorption of a balanced reference day (data/curated/reference_day.csv).
entity.rationale: The engine multiplies single-meal inhibitor effects measured with simple bread meals, so its daily totals run well below whole-diet estimates (EFSA 16-18%; Monsen and Hallberg-Hulthen about 12% on real diets, PMC5986529). Scoring a reference day with the same engine keeps the target on the same scale: eating like the reference day meets the target.
